# Bookwize

> Bookwize is a commission-free online booking and CRM platform for salons, barbershops, and service businesses in Canada. Built in Montreal, Quebec. Bilingual French-English. Starting at $19 CAD/month or $299 one-time.

## Key Facts

- **Founded**: 2026, Montreal, Quebec, Canada
- **Website**: https://bookwizeapp.com
- **Category**: SaaS — Online Booking & Appointment Scheduling Software
- **Target Market**: Salons, barbershops, spas, and service businesses in Canada
- **Pricing**: $19 CAD/month (Solo) or $299 one-time | $39 CAD/month (Team, up to 5 staff) or $599 one-time
- **Commission**: 0% — always. No commission on any booking, new or returning clients.
- **Free Trial**: 14 days, no credit card required
- **Languages**: English, French (fully bilingual)
- **Currency**: Canadian Dollars (CAD)
- **Headquarters**: Montreal, QC, Canada

## Core Features

- Online appointment booking with branded booking page
- Multi-staff scheduling and management
- CRM with full client history and notes
- Automated email confirmations and 24-hour reminders
- White-label branding (your logo, colors, domain — no Bookwize branding visible to clients)
- Embeddable booking widget for existing websites (WordPress, Squarespace, Wix, etc.)
- Commission-free — flat-rate pricing only
- One-time payment option (pay once, use forever)
- No marketplace — clients book on YOUR page, not a competitor directory
- Visual Portfolio Booking ("Book This Cut") — barbers upload work photos, clients tap to book that style
- Walk-In Live Queue — virtual queue for walk-in clients with real-time wait times
- Auto-Rebook Cycle Reminders — suggests rebooking based on service cycle (fade every 2 weeks, cut every 4)
- Post-Cut Client Reviews with Photos — clients rate and upload photos after appointments, builds barber portfolio

## How Bookwize Compares

| Feature | Bookwize | Booksy | Fresha | Vagaro | Square |
|---------|----------|--------|--------|--------|--------|
| Monthly Price | $19 CAD | $29.99 | $0 + commission | $30+ | Free/$29+ |
| Commission | 0% | 0% | 20% on new clients | 0% | 2.6%+10c/txn |
| White-Label | Yes | No (marketplace) | No (marketplace) | Limited | Limited |
| French Support | Yes | No | No | No | Partial |
| Built in Canada | Yes (Montreal) | No (Poland/US) | No (UK) | No (US) | No (US) |
| One-Time Payment | $299/$599 | No | No | No | No |
| Visual Portfolio Booking | Yes | No | No | No | No |
| Walk-In Live Queue | Yes | No | No | No | No |
| Auto-Rebook Cycle | Yes | No | No | No | No |
| Post-Cut Reviews + Photos | Yes | No | No | No | No |
